summary: V031_READY: BLOCKED — the v0.3.1 candidate fixes the published v0.3.0 default-install peer conflict and passes the standalone plain-npm gate, frozen install, full deterministic tests, client build, and package audit. The required normal-resolver install alongside the supported official @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 cohort was stopped after npm resource expansion, so the cohort acceptance gate is not PASS.

tests.name: T01 Task Contract validation and source checkout
tests.evidence: The task validator returned VALID TASK CONTRACT. The worktree was on main after fast-forward pull at exact source commit a238766f41d6dc197c1293f09023e87fe35f39c5 and was clean before execution.

tests.name: T02 Published v0.3.0 default npm install reproduction
tests.evidence: A fresh disposable normal npm install of @ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.3.0 exited 1 with ERESOLVE. The graph showed dsh-crew requiring @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent@0.1.0-rc.6 while npm selected @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools@0.1.0-rc.8, whose peer requires @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent@^0.1.0-rc.8; the rc.6 spine-demo/instructions packages accepted the older tools range, creating the mixed-cohort conflict.

tests.name: T03 Authoritative public DSH manifest and cohort audit
tests.evidence: Public registry manifests and dist-tags identified @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 as the supported latest/next cohort. The direct DSH peer packages used by dsh-crew all exposed 0.1.1-rc.2, while the implicated rc.6/rc.8 manifests confirmed the reproduced conflict.

tests.name: T04 Minimal peer metadata compatibility fix
tests.evidence: All 20 direct DSH peer and dev dependency pins were aligned to the exact authoritative 0.1.1-rc.2 cohort, with no wildcard weakening or resolver bypass. The lockfile was regenerated only through pnpm.

tests.name: T05 v0.3.1 package/runtime/changelog identity
tests.evidence: package.json version, src/runtime-identity.mjs RUNTIME_VERSION, and the top CHANGELOG.md release heading consistently identify 0.3.1 and describe the install compatibility fix.

tests.name: T06 Frozen dependency installation
tests.evidence: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile exited 0 after the DSH cohort lockfile update.

tests.name: T07 Packed candidate standalone plain npm install
tests.evidence: pnpm run verify:npm-install returned NPM_INSTALL_CONTRACT=PASS candidate=0.3.1 official_dsh=not-run. The disposable candidate tarball installed with npm's normal resolver and no peer bypass; the installed package/runtime were 0.3.1 and src/hub/entry.mjs plus lib/client.js were present. A manual smoke installed 208 packages successfully.

tests.name: T08 Packed candidate with official DSH cohort
tests.evidence: A disposable normal-resolver install of the candidate alongside @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 did not complete within safe resource/time bounds; npm expanded to roughly 900 MB and sustained high CPU for several minutes, so it was stopped with Ctrl+C. No resolver bypass flag was used and no PASS was claimed.

tests.name: T09 Full deterministic test sweep
tests.evidence: node --test test/*.test.mjs exited 0 with 426 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 cancelled, and 0 skipped.

tests.name: T10 Client build and generated-artifact boundary
tests.evidence: pnpm run build:client exited 0. The tracked generated lib/client.js build side effect was restored, leaving no unintended generated-artifact diff.

tests.name: T11 npm pack dry-run and payload audit
tests.evidence: npm pack --dry-run --json reported @ran-sh/dsh-crew version 0.3.1 with 86 payload files. The audit found no ACTIVE task/result, temporary, secret, node_modules, or test-only payload entries.

tests.name: T12 Final diff and workspace hygiene
tests.evidence: git diff --check passed. Disposable directories created for the v0.3.0 reproduction and v0.3.1 smoke attempts were removed; the remaining implementation scope is limited to the task's allowed package, lockfile, changelog, runtime identity, and scripts paths pending result/task completion files.

blockers: The required disposable normal-resolver install of the v0.3.1 candidate alongside @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 did not complete within safe resource/time bounds; npm consumed roughly 900 MB and sustained high CPU, so the run was stopped. No resolver bypass was used, therefore the official DSH cohort gate cannot be marked PASS.
notes: source_branch: main; source_commit=LATEST resolved after pull to a238766f41d6dc197c1293f09023e87fe35f39c5.

The candidate is prepared only: @ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.3.1 was not published, no npm registry mutation or dist-tag mutation occurred, no git tag was created or changed, and no GitHub Release was created or changed.

The regression gate defaults to the standalone candidate install; its optional official-cohort mode records the exact host as @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 and uses npm's normal resolver without bypass flags.
No official DSH state, credential store, provider key file, or secret was accessed or modified.
Completion is limited to the authorized implementation paths, this Result Contract, and deletion of docs/agent-tasks/ACTIVE_TASK.json.
